title: ext/Inbox has no page.js — can't get an icon or appear on /framework/

message.text: core/Page/ext/Inbox/ has a readme.md and Inbox.js but no page.js, so it's unroutable and nobody can give it an icon or a dark class card. Found while auditing icons for the framework-home task (2026-10-02) — the brief named ext/Inbox as an example, but it isn't a page at all. Give it a page.js (subject: Inbox, an icon) like every other class module, then it'll pick up the dark card automatically.
